instruction: How many months of amazon prime subscription do I still have left? Round to the nearest number.
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are required (evaluation asserts no model changes), so the goal only demands that the remaining-months value has been retrieved and the task completed with it as the answer. The remaining-months quantity is modeled as a single discrete object (months-left) linked statically to the active prime subscription; amazon.show_prime_subscriptions discovers it (found-months-left), and supervisor-complete-task passes it as the `answer`. The current datetime (2023-05-19) is given in the task, so no phone.get_current_date_and_time call is needed. The reference solution has 5 calls (likely an extra inspection such as amazon.show_account or paging); the minimal valid plan here is 4 calls.
